name: Roman Tribunal
description: The strife-torn Hermetic Tribunal covering Italy, marked by constant bickering between covenants and meetings held every seven years in Venice.

name: Levant Tribunal
description: Tribunal existing since shortly after the Order's founding that gained attention during the crusades; home of the Covenant of Al Arama.

name: Provençal Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing Doissetep; predicted to come into conflict with the Roman Tribunal from 1266.

name: Hibernia Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing the Covenant of Circulus Ruber, reachable by a Harco Hermes Portal.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing the Covenant of Durenmar, reachable by a Harco Hermes Portal.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Harco has a Hermes Portal to a small tower north of Madrid.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Harco has a Portal to a Redcap-run inn in Tours.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Harco has a Portal to a cottage with stables near Coventry.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Harco has a Portal to a cabin near Kiev.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal; one in 1294 is where the Provençal-Roman conflict comes to a head.

name: Harco
description: Domus Magnus of House Mercere in the hills of Piedmont, founded 776/778, a wealthy mercantile covenant controlling Hermes Portals and messages across the Order.

name: Rellantali
description: Roman covenant founded 838 on Asinara whose Tytalus magi run Venice's thieves and spies and hold a fief from Pisa; long hates Verdi.

name: Magvillus
description: Domus Magnus of the Quaesitores founded 830, enforcer of the Treaty of the Roman Tribunal; owns the warehouse where Tribunal meetings are held.

name: Verdi
description: Domus Magnus founded 775 that supplies magic items; long-time enemy of Rellantali and trades with Al Arama.

name: Auctus
description: Roman covenant founded 793 and destroyed in 888.

name: Calabria
description: Roman covenant founded 841 that disbanded in 907.

name: Postestas
description: Tremere covenant founded 870 that claims innocence in Tribunal plots but always picks sides to appear helpful; feuding with Vardian's Tomb.

name: Sansaron
description: Vis-rich covenant founded 951 on the north coast of Africa that shuns Tribunal meetings and leaves its Venetian townhouse empty.

name: Literatus
description: Jerbiton covenant founded 1001 with Pope Sylvester II near Bologna; outwardly a scholarly covenant, secretly devoted to diabolism.

name: Vardian's Tomb
description: Powerful independent covenant founded 1014 within a catacomb southwest of Rome; its Jerbiton meet with the Pope.

name: Luctatio
description: Tytalus covenant founded 1172 in war-torn Lombardy near Milan that secretly stirs conflict between Roman covenants.

name: Al Arama
description: Levant Tribunal covenant that trades vis to Rellantali, Verdi and Harco and is reachable by a Harco Hermes Portal.

name: Feritel
description: Independent covenant that is a subject commune of Genoa, described in Chapter Five.

name: Doissetep
description: Powerful Provençal Tribunal covenant with its own Hermes Portal from Harco and a huge mundane library.

name: Circulus Ruber
description: Covenant in the Hibernia Tribunal reachable via Harco's Hermes Portals.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant in the Rhine Tribunal reachable via Harco's Hermes Portals.

name: Windgraven
description: Covenant whose magi are predicted to enter the Roman Tribunal in 1266, sparking Provençal-Roman conflict.

name: Mistridge
description: Covenant whose magi move against Windgraven in Italy in 1282.

name: Naples Covenant
description: Covenant founded in Naples by apprentices of Literatus that continues Literatus' work after its disbanding.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House; two Flambeau magi were banished in 1162 for joining the destruction of Milan.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose magi founded Luctatio and are among the violent magi of Rellantali.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House defending involvement in mundane politics; founded Literatus and populates Vardian's Tomb.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House of Redcaps centred on Harco, responsible for delivering messages across the Order.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House of the magi of Postestas.

name: House Quaesitor
description: Hermetic House of investigators and judges, based at Magvillus.

name: House Díedne
description: Hermetic House persecuted by other Houses in the Schism War.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Germanic Hermetic House known for shapechanging magic.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organisation of Hermetic magi, founded in 767.

name: Treaty of the Roman Tribunal
description: 1068 treaty regulating Roman magi's dealings with the mundane world; part of the Peripheral Code but with no force outside the Roman Tribunal.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of Hermetic legal rulings usable as precedent in other Tribunals.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Order's law, which magi meddling in mundane wars risk breaking.

name: Independent Magi
description: Magi in Italy belonging to no recognized covenant; by 1095 they outnumbered chartered magi.

name: Independent Covenants
description: Covenants in the Roman Tribunal not officially recognized by the Tribunal.

name: Hermetic Mercenaries
description: Magi hired by communes as guardsmen, thieves or assassins, working covertly.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; scarce in the Roman Tribunal, imported from the Levant and elsewhere.

name: Botch
description: A disastrous failure on a roll.

name: Season
description: Unit of time used for work and study; Tribunal meetings last about a Season.

name: Certamen
description: Formal Hermetic magical duel; has resulted from conflicting mercenary loyalties.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal Hermetic war between magi.

name: Wizard's March
description: Hermetic punishment of being Marched; Luctatio has so far avoided it.

name: Arcane Connection
description: An object linked to a person that can be used to target magic; thieves steal trinkets for this use.

name: Domus Magnus
description: The central covenant of a House; Harco, Magvillus and Verdi are Domus Magni.

name: Redcap
description: Messenger of House Mercere, mostly lacking magic; also a Virtue.

name: Grog
description: Covenant soldiers and servants; Roman covenants station a fifth of theirs in Venice.

name: Companion
description: Non-magus player character type.

name: Covenfolk
description: The mundane staff and residents of a covenant.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator-judge; foreign Quaesitores are exempt from the Venice announcement rule.

name: Praeco
description: Presiding officer of a Tribunal; Insatella is Praeco of the Roman Tribunal.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House; Harco houses the Prima of Mercere.

name: Arch-Mage
description: Hermetic title of eminence held by Amberitus, normally contested by magical test.

name: Tribunal Meeting
description: Seven-yearly gathering of Roman magi in Venice lasting about a Season.

name: Covenant Townhouses in Venice
description: Townhouses every Roman covenant maintains in Venice as centres of intrigue, information and learning.

name: Magvillus Warehouse
description: Large Venetian warehouse owned by Magvillus where Tribunal meetings are held, rumoured haunted.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural influence of a place, e.g. Magic, Divine, Infernal or Reason auras.

name: Magic Aura
description: Aura of the Magic Realm; Harco has Magic 2 and Literatus' labs +2.

name: Divine Aura
description: Aura of the Divine; Venice's townhouses have Divine Aura 2.

name: Aura of Reason
description: Aura growing from learning and rational thought in Florence, Bologna, Palermo and Literatus, a threat to magic.

name: Infernal Aura
description: Subtle Infernal auras arising in Bologna where students seek forbidden knowledge.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural region; a Divine regio may surround the Church in Milan.

name: Twilight
description: Magical experience caused by Warping; Insatella's Painful Magic and Arthritis stem from Twilight.

name: Longevity Potion
description: Magical potion slowing aging; made at Harco by Elegans and Velox.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant protective ritual; Harco's is Level 20, Literatus has none for lack of vis.

name: Hermes Portals
description: Magical gateways held by Harco leading to every Tribunal of the Order, usable only by Redcaps.

name: Harco's Magical Ships
description: Four enchanted ships of Harco that never lack wind, cannot sink and always find home port.

name: Brazen Head
description: Infamous, supposedly Infernal scrying tool acquired by Sylvester II in Spain.

name: Wizard's Sigil
description: Distinctive trait marking a magus' spells.

name: Schism War
description: Hermetic war in which Díedne was persecuted; Harco's archives are the best record of it.

name: Age of Chaos
description: Period 412-767 between disbanding of the Cult of Mercury and founding of the Order.

name: Hermetic Law
description: Law of the Order; mandatory education in it has been proposed for Roman magi.

name: Diabolism
description: Infernal worship pervading commune governments, Literatus and Italian cities.

name: True Faith
description: Holy power granted by Divine relics to the faithful.

name: Mercurian Ritual
description: Ritual magic of the Cult of Mercury; the rite of Saint Ambrose may bear its aspects.

name: Consortis
description: Intermediaries through which mercenary magi deal money under the Treaty.

name: Crusades
description: Wars to the Levant that reduced Roman Hermetic population and brought in vis.

name: Fourth Crusade
description: Crusade transported by Venice that sacked Zara and Constantinople, returning Greek and Byzantine lore.

name: Infernal
description: The realm of demons, deeply entwined with Italian politics and Literatus.

name: Divine
description: Realm of God, manifest in relics and Divine auras.

name: Magic Realm
description: The realm of magic, waning in Italy.

name: Reason
description: Rising force of rational thought producing Auras of Reason that may discount magic.

name: Greek Cult of Hermes
description: Cult that came to Italy c. 700 B.C.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Roman cult founded c. 600 B.C., disbanded A.D. 412, whose artifacts lie in Rome's ruins.

name: Guelphs
description: Papal party in Italian urban factional struggles.

name: Ghibellines
description: Imperial party opposing the Guelphs; the Visconti are Ghibellines.

name: The Blacks
description: Radical Guelph faction of Florence that blackmails magi into service.

name: Lombard League
description: League of Lombard cities that Pavia and Montferrat refuse to join.

name: Credenza di San Ambrogio
description: The popolo of Milan in 1202, which chose its own council.

name: Popolo
description: Political societies of wealthy tradesmen opposing the magnates in the communes.

name: Communes
description: Northern Italian city-republics independent of the Holy Roman Empire.

name: Della Torre Family
description: Milanese family, many corrupted by pacts with Peris, defeated by the Visconti in 1277.

name: Visconti Family
description: Ghibelline Milanese family that defeats the Della Torre in 1277.

name: Frangipane Family
description: Roman family using the Colosseum as a fortress.

name: Savelli Family
description: Roman family controlling the ruined temple to Jupiter used as a fish market.

name: Orsini Family
description: One of the great noble families holding real power in Rome.

name: Conti Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Colonna Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Annibaldi Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Capocci Family
description: One of Rome's great noble families.

name: Order of Trinitarians
description: Religious order founded by Giovanni of Matha.

name: Thieves of Venice
description: Burglar guild using tunnels beneath Venice, organized by Rellantali.

name: Papal Curia
description: The corrupt papal court in Rome.

name: Grand Council of Venice
description: Council of 480 true rulers of Venice, perpetuating Infernal activity.

name: Lombards
description: Long-bearded barbarians who ruled Italy from Pavia until 774.

name: Normans
description: Northern mercenaries who became rulers of the Kingdom of Sicily.

name: Saracens
description: Muslims who once occupied Sicily and besieged Palermo in 1199 with sorcerers and djinn.

name: Holy Roman Empire
description: Empire from which the communes declared independence.

name: Saracen Sorcerers
description: Non-Hermetic Muslim magicians of Africa and the Saracen armies.

name: Papal States
description: Central Italian lands ruled by the Pope, including Rome, Florence and Bologna.

name: University of Law at Bologna
description: University recently founded by Literatus' magi and apprentices, adding students to Infernal ranks.

name: Iernilus
description: Quaesitor who came to the Roman Tribunal in 1061 to arbitrate, leading to the Treaty.

name: Tamgor
description: Quaesitor who toured the Roman Tribunal in 1196 to bring information to Jarane.

name: Jarane
description: Quaesitor leading three foreign Quaesitores to Venice to set the Roman Tribunal straight.

name: Frederick II
description: Emperor allied with Literatus who later corrupts it; opposed by Roman magi.

name: Peris
description: Demon working through lesser demons in northern Italy, who takes flesh in Eccelino.

name: Eccelino
description: Man in whom the demon Peris takes flesh in 1237.

name: Frederick Barbarossa
description: Infernally tainted emperor who created the office of Podesta and destroyed Milan.

name: Saint Ambrose
description: Patron saint of Milan whose rite is used by its Church.

name: King Albion
description: Lombard king under whom Pavia became capital.

name: Charlemagne
description: King to whom Pavia fell in 774.

name: Henry Dandolo
description: Doge of Venice who led the Fourth Crusade to Zara and Constantinople.

name: Pope Innocent III
description: Pope who recognized the crusaders after Constantinople's fall.

name: Emperor Aurelian
description: 3rd-century emperor who built Rome's walls.

name: Giovanni of Matha
description: Urban hermit living in the Acqua Claudia ruins who founds the Trinitarians and is canonized.

name: Saint Peter
description: Greatest Apostle whose relics lie in the Vatican and head in the Lateran.

name: Saint Paul
description: Apostle whose head is kept in the Lateran.

name: Cardinal-Bishop of Ostia
description: Chief clergyman of Ostia who views magi as a great threat.

name: Pope Sylvester II
description: Diabolical pope who co-founded Literatus in 1001 and possessed the Brazen Head; may still live.

name: Archbishop of Bologna
description: Current archbishop hostile to Literatus but bound by Sylvester's agreement.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere who founded Harco.

name: Aldico
description: Primus of Mercere during the Schism War who helped negotiate peace.

name: Insatella
description: Aged Prima of House Mercere, leader of Harco and Praeco of the Roman Tribunal, a lover of trade.

name: Aldero
description: Elder member of Harco overseeing mercantile activities.

name: Harstein
description: Elder member of Harco overseeing daily operations.

name: Elegans
description: Magus of Mercere at Harco who makes longevity potions and magic items.

name: Velox
description: Magus of Mercere at Harco maintaining defenses and making items.

name: Pipio
description: Scribe of Harco.

name: Spica
description: Scribe of Harco.

name: Tentare
description: Scribe of Harco.

name: Antho
description: Youngest Redcap of Harco, corrupt and politically ambitious, selling and forging letters.

name: Frederick of Harco
description: One of Harco's three young Redcaps.

name: Iris
description: One of Harco's three young Redcaps.

name: Amberitus
description: Arch-Mage of Jerbiton and leader and coven master of Literatus, with strongest Infernal ties.

name: Arichis
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Carlos
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Duro
description: Youngest magus of Literatus, wishing to pursue the Dark Arts in seclusion.

name: Exileratus
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Favila
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the school of Medicine.

name: Gerbert
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

name: Roger
description: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching the Humanities.

name: Andrea
description: Grog Captain of Literatus, a skilled swordswoman.

name: Podesta
description: Commune office created by Frederick Barbarossa, usually held by Infernally tainted outsiders.

name: Doge
description: Chief magistrate of Venice.

name: Djinn
description: Spirits accompanying Moslem sorcerers attacking Palermo.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings corrupting Italian cities and Literatus.

name: Italy
description: Peninsula comprising the Roman Tribunal, divided among communes, Papal States and the Kingdom of Sicily.

name: Rome
description: Greatest city of Mythic Europe, centre of the Church, full of ruins, relics and corruption.

name: Venice
description: Republic on a lagoon; after the Treaty the heart of Hermetic politics and site of Tribunal meetings.

name: Genoa
description: Maritime commune, enemy of Pisa; Feritel is its subject commune.

name: Pavia
description: Imperialist commune and former Lombard capital full of family towers.

name: Pisa
description: Maritime commune rival of Genoa; grants Rellantali its fief.

name: Milan
description: Wealthy anti-imperial commune destroyed by Barbarossa and rebuilt.

name: Lombardy
description: War-torn northern region, site of Luctatio.

name: Tuscany
description: Region where magi reputedly serve on councils.

name: The Levant
description: Eastern Mediterranean region supplying vis to Rome.

name: Jerusalem
description: City recaptured by the Moslems.

name: Po Valley
description: Northern valley occupied by the communes.

name: Ostia
description: Port 25 miles from Rome.

name: Florence
description: Commune of the Papal States with growing Auras of Reason.

name: Bologna
description: City of schools and universities where Literatus is based.

name: Kingdom of Sicily
description: Most stable Italian state, covering Sicily and southern Italy.

name: Palermo
description: Intellectual centre of Sicily with libraries and Auras of Reason; besieged 1199.

name: Naples
description: City where a covenant is founded by Literatus apprentices.

name: Sardinia
description: Island contested by Genoa and Pisa.

name: Corsica
description: Island claimed by the Genoese Church.

name: Asinara
description: Island home of Rellantali.

name: Montferrat
description: City refusing to join the Lombard League.

name: Zara
description: City captured in the Fourth Crusade.

name: Constantinople
description: Capital of the Eastern Roman Empire captured in the Fourth Crusade.

name: Piedmont
description: Hills where Harco lies.

name: Harco Village
description: Village below Harco populated by covenfolk relatives.

name: Tunis
description: City where Harco has a Portal in a merchant's house.

name: Madrid
description: Harco has a Portal to a tower north of it.

name: Tours
description: Site of a Redcap inn with a Harco Portal.

name: Coventry
description: Site near a Harco Portal cottage.

name: Kiev
description: Site near a Harco Portal cabin.

name: Colosseum
description: Ancient ruin used by the Frangipane as a fortress.

name: Temple of Jupiter
description: Ruined temple near the Theater of Marcellus, now a fish market tainted by artifacts.

name: Theater of Marcellus
description: Ancient Roman ruin.

name: Acqua Claudia
description: Ruined aqueduct home to Giovanni of Matha.

name: Catacombs of Rome
description: Underground Christian burial mazes; one houses Vardian's Tomb.

name: Vatican
description: Walled basilica housing Saint Peter's relics.

name: Basilica of Saint John Lateran
description: Cathedral of Rome and papal seat holding the heads of Peter and Paul.

name: Lateran Palace
description: Usual residence of the Pope.

name: Castel Sant'Angelo
description: Fortress used by the Papal court in need.

name: Saint Mark's Square
description: Venetian square where the General Assembly meets.

name: Tiber
description: River of Rome.

name: Anagni
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Perugia
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Viterbo
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Orvieto
description: City visited by the Pope.

name: Sienna
description: City whose 1257 offices numbered 860.

name: Africa
description: Largely unclaimed by the Order; possible expansion target.

name: Western Roman Empire
description: Empire with Milan as capital from 305.

name: Eastern Roman Empire
description: Empire whose capital was Constantinople.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting.

name: Spain
description: Where Sylvester II gained the Brazen Head.

name: Paris
description: Centre of learning with Literatus apprentices.

name: Hell
description: Where souls are lost.

name: Padus
description: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

name: Treviso
description: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

name: Vicenza
description: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

name: Verona
description: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

name: Literatus Manor House
description: New three-story manor southwest of Bologna housing Literatus since 1180.

name: Redcap
description: Virtue marking a member of House Mercere's messenger ranks.

name: The Gentle Gift
description: The Gift without the usual social penalty.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Influence in the mundane world.

name: Greater Leadership
description: Major leadership virtue.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Widely traveled.

name: Wealth
description: Personal riches.

name: Long-Winded
description: +3 to Fatigue rolls.

name: Strong-Willed
description: +3 on willpower rolls.

name: Versatile Sleeper
description: Can sleep anywhere.

name: Magical Affinity

name: Strong Writer
description: Writes well.

name: Arthritis
description: Botched physical actions seize joints.

name: Painful Magic
description: Casting magic is painful.

name: Over-Confident
description: Excessive self-confidence.

name: Major Magic Deficiency
description: Scores involving Vim are halved.
